## Concerns
- The specialization is mislabeled: the interval has \(i=j=2\), \(p=2\), \(c=3\), hence \(a=b=2\), not \(a=3,b=2\).
- It duplicates an existing \(a=b=2\) case and covers only degrees \(4,\ldots,10\) of support \(4,\ldots,20\).
- No Smith witnesses \(U_dM_dV_d=D_d\) were produced. The draft correctly states that the requested target was not established.

## Unresolved certificates
- [computation] Execute the genuinely new case \([2,2,2,0,0,0]\subseteq\lambda\subseteq[5,5,5,5,5,5]\) in every degree \(6,\ldots,30\), using \(h_1,\ldots,h_5\), with complete Pieri rows and verified integral witnesses \(U_dM_dV_d=D_d\); report degreewise quotient ranks, torsion, and any structural obstruction.
